parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main door panel of the Door Set, typically made of wood. It is a flat rectangular component that fits within the frame.
parts.Functional_description: The door serves as the movable barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing it to swing open or closed.

parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the Door Set, typically made of steel. It surrounds and supports the door panel.
parts.Functional_description: The frame provides structural support and alignment for the door, ensuring smooth operation and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place and does not move during normal operation.
